policy.what: US DOJ criminal case (EDNY 24-cr-433; alleged ~$265M Indian solar-contract bribery scheme): DOJ moved to dismiss May 2026; Judge Nicholas Garaufis permanently dismissed securities- and wire-fraud charges against Gautam Adani, Sagar Adani and Vineet Jain on 10 Aug 2026 while criticising DOJ; refused to drop two counts against five co-defendants pending more DOJ submissions
SEC v. Adani (EDNY 24-civ-8080): settled without admitting/denying; court approved final judgments ordering civil penalties of $6M (Gautam) and $12M (Sagar Adani) plus antifraud injunctions
Court filings showed Adani's lawyers offered a $10B US investment 'as part of any resolution' of the criminal case; Senators Warren and Blumenthal pressed DOJ for answers (24 Sep 2026)

SEBI closed Hindenburg-related proceedings against Adani group and Gautam Adani, finding no violation (18 Sep 2025)
